en-US.description: Windows search launcher with pinyin file search, document full-text search, clipboard history and an MCP server.
en-US.longDescription: WinShun (Win顺) is a free, open-source Windows search launcher and an alternative to Everything and Listary. Double-tap Ctrl to open the search box: find files and folders by pinyin, search the text inside Word, Excel and PDF documents, browse clipboard history instead of Win+V, search in dialogs and on the taskbar, extend it with plugins, and expose it to AI assistants through a MCP server. An optional index service reads the NTFS master file table and change journal, so WinShun itself runs with normal user rights and nothing it launches is elevated. Requires a 64-bit Windows 10 (version 1809 or later) or Windows 11.

zh-CN.description: 免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器：拼音搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史与 MCP 服务。
zh-CN.longDescription: Win顺（WinShun）是一款免费、开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器，可作为 Everything 与 Listary 的替代方案。双击 Ctrl 唤出搜索框：用拼音搜索文件和文件夹、搜索 Word/Excel/PDF 的正文内容、用剪贴板历史代替 Win+V、在对话框和任务栏里搜索、通过插件扩展能力，并以 MCP 服务接入 AI 助手。可选的索引服务负责读取 NTFS 主文件表和变更日志，因此 Win顺 平时以普通用户权限运行，由它打开的程序也不提权。需要 64 位的 Windows 10（1809 或更新版本）或 Windows 11。
zh-CN.name: Win顺
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Win 顺 0.25.0 让常用的搜索条件一点就用：把“排除回收站”“10 MB 以上的 PDF”这样的条件存成快捷筛选，在面板里点一下套用，或在搜索框里打 :前缀。结果上按 F2 就地重命名；预览给代码和 Markdown 上色，Illustrator 和 Photoshop 文件直接显示成图片；剪贴板记录可以加自己的备注并按备注搜到。另外重做了首次启动的引导，修复 Directory Opus 停在“此电脑”时打字不出搜索框、插件启动时搜索框被关掉等问题。 WinShun 0.25.0 puts the conditions you keep typing one click away: save "leave the Recycle Bin out" or "PDFs over 10 MB" as a quick filter, switch it on in the panel, or type its :prefix in the box. F2 renames a result in place; the preview colours code and Markdown and draws Illustrator and Photoshop files as pictures; a clipboard entry can carry a note of your own that the search finds. The first-run setup is redone, and fixes include typing in Directory Opus on This PC and the search box closing as a plugin starts.
新功能 · What's new
- 🔖 快捷筛选 把常用的搜索条件起个名字存起来（比如“排除回收站” !$RECYCLE.BIN\、“大 PDF” ext:pdf size:>10mb），在搜索面板的筛选里点一下套用、再点取消，搜索框里的字不动；同时开几个就要全部满足，搜“内容”时同样有效。给它填一个搜索前缀，普通搜索框里打 :nobin 报告 也能用。在 设置 › 结果列表 › 类型与筛选 管理。面板的筛选也改成了左侧一列窄列表，或一键换成结果上方的一行。
  Quick filters Save a query under a name ("no Recycle Bin" !$RECYCLE.BIN\, "big PDFs" ext:pdf size:>10mb) and switch it on and off with a click in the search panel, leaving what you typed alone; several at once must all match, and content searches obey them too. Give one a prefix and :nobin report applies it from the plain box. Managed under Settings › Result list › Kinds and filters. The panel's filters are now a narrow list at the left, or one line over the rows.
- ✏️ F2 就地重命名 在文件或文件夹的结果上按 F2（或右键选“重命名”），名字变成输入框，扩展名之前的部分已选好；Enter 生效，Esc 取消。名字不能用或已有同名文件时底栏会说明。和在资源管理器里改名一样，可以在资源管理器里按 Ctrl+Z 撤销。
  Rename in place with F2 F2 on a file or folder (or Rename in its menu) turns the name into a box with everything before the extension selected; Enter renames, Esc leaves it. A refused or taken name is explained in the footer. It is a shell rename, so Ctrl+Z in File Explorer takes it back.
- 🎨 预览：代码上色，设计稿直接看 代码、JSON、YAML、INI/TOML、XML/HTML 按语法上色，Markdown 的标题、粗体、代码和链接各有样式；搜索的词加粗标出并自动滚到第一处。Illustrator 的 .ai 和 Photoshop 的 .psd / .psb 直接按图片显示，不用装 Adobe 软件，.ai 会自动去掉画板上的大片空白。
  Preview: coloured code, design files as pictures Code, JSON, YAML, INI / TOML and XML / HTML are coloured by syntax and Markdown is styled; the words searched for are marked and scrolled into sight. Illustrator .ai and Photoshop .psd / .psb files are drawn as pictures without Adobe's software, an .ai trimmed to what is drawn on its artboard.
- 📝 剪贴板记录加备注 在一条记录上右键选“加备注…”，打一句自己的话（比如“学校 收件地址”）。备注用粗体显示在记录前面，搜索时打备注里的词（拼音也行）就能找到它。
  Notes on clipboard entries Add note in an entry's menu takes a line of your own ("school address"). It leads the entry in bold, and the search finds the entry by the note's words, pinyin included.
- ⌨️ 打开结果更顺手 可以在 设置 › 结果列表 › 操作习惯 给 Enter 配一个备用键（比如 Alt+Q、F1），左手不用离开字母区。只打一个字母时，打开过的应用里有字以它开头的也会列出来：用 yy 打开过“网易云音乐”，之后打 y 它就在前面。
  Opening results with less reach Settings › Result list › Behavior can record a second key for Enter (Alt+Q, F1), so the left hand stays on the letters. A single letter now also lists apps opened before whose name has a character starting with it.
- 📂 对话框搜索框只搜当前文件夹 在“打开 / 另存为”旁的搜索框里按 Ctrl+Shift+D（或在“…”菜单里选），就只找对话框正显示的那个文件夹和它下面的内容，对话框换了文件夹它跟着换。文件类型也可以绑定文件夹：cw: 只列某个工作文件夹里的 CSV（感谢 @QueCue）。
  The dialog bar can search only the dialog's folder Ctrl+Shift+D in the bar beside Open / Save dialogs (or its "…" menu) searches only the folder the dialog shows and what lies in it, following the dialog. A file kind can be bound to folders too: cw: lists the CSV files of one work folder (thanks to @QueCue).
- 🧭 首次启动的引导重做 左右两栏，一眼看全，不用滚动：左边是当前选的呼出按键（可以当场试），右边是两步选择。在引导里打开截图就算同意它需要的权限，不再多问一次。
  A new first-run setup Two panes with everything in sight and nothing scrolled: the keys that open WinShun at the left, to be tried on the spot, and the two steps at the right. Turning the screenshot on there is the consent it needs, with no second question.
- 🧩 插件 命令和结果的图标可以直接写 Phosphor 图标名（ph:heart、ph-fill:heart，全套 1500 多个，不依赖 Windows 版本，感谢 @ra9fael）。需要管理员权限的插件，卡片上会写明现在以什么身份运行，并有“以管理员身份重新启动”的按钮；搜索框里打“管理员”或 admin 也能找到。只打一个即时命令的关键字（如 ocr）时，文件和应用的结果不再被挤掉。
  Plugins Commands and items can name any bundled Phosphor icon (ph:heart, ph-fill:heart; over 1,500, the same on every Windows; thanks to @ra9fael). The card of a plugin that needs administrator rights says how it runs now, with a Restart as administrator button, also found by typing admin in the box. An instant command's keyword typed alone (ocr) no longer takes the files and apps off the list.
改进与修复 · Improvements and fixes
- Directory Opus 里打字搜索：标签页停在“此电脑”、库或压缩包里时，现在也会打开搜索框，搜整个电脑（#82）。
  Typing to search in Directory Opus: a tab on This PC, a library or inside an archive now opens the box too, for the whole PC (#82).
- 插件启动时搜索框不再被关掉：有的插件一启动就把一个看不见的窗口放到最前面，搜索框以为你点了别处而关闭。现在它会留着并拿回焦点（#242）。
  The search box stays as a plugin starts: some plugins put a window nobody can see in front, and the box left as for a click elsewhere. It now stays and takes the front back (#242).
- 剪贴板“按住连按、松开粘贴”在以管理员身份运行的程序上也能用了（要开着“粘贴到以管理员身份运行的程序”，#287）。
  The clipboard's "hold and press again, release to paste" now works over programs run as administrator too, while pasting into them is on (#287).
- 设置窗口：打开时不再有一闪的淡入；在另一种缩放的屏幕上再次打开，宽度不再出错。
  Settings window: no fade-like flash when it opens, and the right size when opened next on a screen of another scale.
- 退出时偶发的崩溃：插件现在先于主程序的其他部分结束。
  A crash on the way out that could happen with a plugin's last call: plugins are now ended before the app's own parts.
- 搜索框里打 winshun、“反馈”或“讨论”，可以直接打开 Win 顺 的问题反馈和讨论区（#254）。
  Typing winshun, issue or 反馈 in the box lists WinShun's issue tracker and discussions (#254).
- 文件类型设置里绑定文件夹的入口改成图标按钮，不再把别的列挤窄；内容搜索不再每次都记一条多余的“结果来晚了”日志。
  The folder a file kind is bound to sits behind an icon button instead of a word that squeezed the other columns; a content search no longer logs a "late rows" line every time.
插件库更新 · Plugin library updates

| 插件 · Plugin                         | 新版本 · Version |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 浏览器书签 · Browser bookmarks        | 2.0.4            |
| 截图与录屏 · Screenshot and recording | 1.1.11           |
| 图片文字搜索 · Image text search      | 1.0.11           |

浏览器书签 2.0.4 现在也读登录 Chrome / Edge 账户后同步的书签（AccountBookmarks；有的配置只有它，以前会一条也搜不到）。它声明读取的文件多了这两个，更新时需要确认一次。另外两个插件跟进主程序的共用代码（按名字取图标、窗口边框、搜索核心），没有各自的功能变化；最低版本分别为 0.18.0 和 0.24.0。
Browser bookmarks 2.0.4 also reads the bookmarks synced to a signed-in Chrome / Edge account (AccountBookmarks; some profiles have nothing else, and nothing was found there before). Its declared files gain these two, so the update asks for your confirmation once. The other two take over the host's shared code (icons by name, the window frame, the search core) with no change of their own, requiring 0.18.0 and 0.24.0.
当前发布的验证范围见 0.25.0 发布验证记录。插件开发者请留意：ph: 图标从 0.25.0 起可用，更早的 Win 顺 会改用命令或插件自己的图标。
See the 0.25.0 release validation record for the verification scope. Plugin authors: ph: icons work from 0.25.0 on; an earlier WinShun falls back to the command's or the plugin's own icon.
